intro: One playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies and no difficulty setting. The story is five chapters and takes 60–80 hours; the 100% checklist after the credits is the long grind at about 100 hours; Strangers & Freaks and cleanup take about 10. There is free roam after the story but no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — the game gives you 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave.
missableWarning: Only one trophy is flagged as possibly missable by any guide: Positive Mental Attitude. During Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you can follow her and choose Accept. That balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
saveAdvice: Keep cheats off for the whole run: turning one on disables trophies and saving. Cheats only unlock after the story anyway.

stages.text: Finish the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear — many disappear after a while, though none of them lock a trophy. While you play, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app, study every new animal through binoculars, try each activity type once, and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation. Side questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret all start during the story and stay available after it.
stages.title: Play the story
stages.trophyNote: Story trophies, side questlines, the missable meditation, vehicle scans and activity tasters.

stages.text: After the credits, the 100% checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Work through it: every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, underwater discoveries, shooting range gold medals, drone races, Bret's 15 target decks, 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 50 of 66 weapons, 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 of 397 stunts. It is only about 60% true completion — most of it is partial credit. Most other trophies pop along the way.
stages.title: 100% checklist & challenges
stages.trophyNote: A Long Road and nearly every grind trophy: stunts, races, robberies, collectibles and money.

stages.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands — only certain questlines count, so check the guide for which strangers those are — then mop up anything left: the partner trophies, the five still-unconfirmed one-offs, and any collectible sets you skipped. When the last one pops, the platinum follows.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
stages.trophyNote: Strangers & Freaks, then the platinum: Vice Got a Price!

title: Road to the Platinum
